_readme: OPTIONAL. The /types folder tree is the structure: folder = accordion, .html file = workspace type. This file only adds labels/overrides. 'title' = top accordion. 'folders' keys are folder paths inside /types. 'types' entries are matched by src (name, id, featured). On hosts without directory listing, run tools/scan-types.py to keep 'types' in sync.
title: Workspace Types
